title: Add cargo-watch dev workflow recipe to justfile
description:
Add `just watch` recipe that runs `cargo watch -x 'nextest run --workspace'` for continuous test feedback during development. Document cargo-watch as a recommended dev dependency (not a required build dependency). Artifact: additional recipe in justfile, dev setup section in CONTRIBUTING.md.

Acceptance: `just watch` starts cargo-watch and re-runs tests on file change; CONTRIBUTING.md mentions cargo-watch as optional dev tool
